sources.title: On the Legal Status of Foreigners and Stateless Persons
sources.officialityEvidence: The Parliament portal marks the law in force, current version 1 July 2026. Article 9 makes a visa the baseline but leaves statutory and treaty exceptions open.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Foreigners and stateless persons enter Ukraine with a passport document and a visa, unless otherwise provided by law or treaty.

sources.title: Requirements for issuing visas in electronic form
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Ukraine / Verkhovna Rada of Ukraine legislation portal
sources.officialityEvidence: The Parliament portal marks MFA Order No. 558 in force, current version 25 March 2025. Annex 3 expressly lists the states whose citizens receive e-Visas.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The list of states whose citizens receive visas in electronic form is provided in Annex 3 to these Requirements.

conflicts.explanation: The in-force eVisa regulation makes Annex 3 the exhaustive list of nationalities receiving eVisas. Taiwan is absent. The default-visa law retains other statutory and treaty exceptions, so it does not establish Taiwan's replacement route.

unresolved.reason: The current default-visa law expressly preserves statutory and treaty exceptions. No current exhaustive waiver instrument or exact ordinary-passport route was recovered; the 2023 MFA table is not current proof.
